name: SpeedPress for WooCommerce
author: Md Laju Miah

sections.description:
SpeedPress for WooCommerce brings a set of modular addons to enhance your WooCommerce store.

Key features:

  • User-friendly dashboard
  • Automatic updates & support ready
  • Easily extendable modular design
  • Compatible with most WooCommerce themes

Each addon is designed to be lightweight and improve user experience while keeping your store fast.

Roadmap

Future updates planned for SpeedPress for WooCommerce include:

  • Additional modular addons for WooCommerce (e.g., advanced shipping, bulk product management)
  • Improved caching and lazy-loading features for product pages
  • Integration with popular page builders (Elementor, WPBakery)
  • Enhanced reporting dashboard for product views, sales, and conversion optimization
  • Improved mobile optimization and Core Web Vitals performance
  • More translation-ready strings and multi-language support
sections.installation:
1. Upload the speedpress-for-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure the individual addons from the SpeedPress settings page.
sections.faq:
Is this plugin compatible with all WooCommerce themes?

Yes, SpeedPress for WooCommerce is designed to work with most themes that follow WooCommerce standards.

Can I enable/disable individual addons?

Yes, each addon is modular and can be toggled individually from the plugin settings page.

Will this plugin affect my store speed?

No, SpeedPress is performance-focused. It is designed to improve speed by optimizing WooCommerce features and removing unnecessary scripts.
